positionMethod.name: Position Method
positionMethod.description: The CSS position method to use for the positioner element.

side.name: Side
side.description: Which side of the anchor element to place the popup on.

align.name: Align
align.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

sideOffset.name: Side Offset
sideOffset.description: The distance in pixels between the popup and the anchor element.

alignOffset.name: Align Offset
alignOffset.description: The offset in pixels along the alignment axis.

collisionPadding.name: Collision Padding
collisionPadding.description: The padding in pixels between the popup and the collision boundary.

arrowPadding.name: Arrow Padding
arrowPadding.description: The padding in pixels between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

sticky.name: Sticky
sticky.description: Whether to keep the popup in view when the anchor is scrolled out of view.

disableAnchorTracking.name: Disable Anchor Tracking
disableAnchorTracking.description: Whether to disable the anchor tracking, which updates the position of the popup when the anchor moves.
